Bug drafts (not filed)

E7High

NDC-3022 · Disabling a department with ticket transfer leaves the ticket record on the old department

Cases
W5-31
Where
Setup › Departments › disable/delete with transfer; Tickets list; Analytics dashboards

Steps

  1. Create a department and a ticket in it.
  2. Disable (then delete) the department and choose Customer Support as the transfer target.
  3. Open Customer Support's ticket list and the Overview dashboard.

Expected

The ticket moves to Customer Support everywhere: list, views, reports and dashboards agree.

Actual

The Desk ticket says Customer Support (history 'department changed', source desk_api) but the ticket record's Department still holds the deleted department. The ticket is missing from Customer Support's list (0 found) while dashboards count it (Open Tickets 19 vs 18 in the list/report). Four round-14 tickets (#1363–#1366) were in the same state.

Request and response (from the run, ids shortened)

POST /desk/departments/{dept}/disable {transfer_to_department_id: Customer Support} → 200
GET /desk/tickets/{t} → department_id = Customer Support
GET /modules/{tickets}/records/{t} → department = <deleted dept>
records filter department = Customer Support → total_count 0

Zoho Desk

Not checked live: the Zoho trial Setup › Departments page stayed on the loading spinner (13 Nov). The defect stands on its own: TAVI's list, records and dashboards disagree about the same ticket.

Evidence

Overview dashboard (19 open); list/report show 18.

E4High

NDC-3023 · New Product cannot be saved from the screen

Cases
W5-60
Where
Setup › Products › New Product

Steps

  1. Open Setup › Products › New Product.
  2. Enter Product Name and a code (Departments is pre-filled with Sales).
  3. Save; then replace Sales with Marketing and Save again.

Expected

The product is saved for the chosen department(s).

Actual

Both saves fail: 'Departments: ["<id>"] is not a valid department id' (422). The form sends departments as a list; the server accepts only a single id (an API call with one id → 201).

Request and response (from the run, ids shortened)

POST /modules/{products}/records … {field: departments, value: {kind: array, items: [{kind: string, value: <Marketing>}]}} → 422 DEPARTMENT_VALUE_INVALID

Zoho Desk

Not checked live: the Zoho trial Setup › Products page stayed on the loading spinner (13 Nov). The defect stands on its own: the screen cannot create any product.

Evidence

Form with the error.

E1Low

NDC-3025 · Mass Update with a field but no value silently clears that field

Cases
W5-44b
Where
Tickets list › select tickets › Update

Steps

  1. Select 2 tickets in a list and click Update.
  2. Choose a field (Priority) and leave the value as 'Select'.
  3. Click Update records.

Expected

Refused ('choose a value') or a clear confirmation that the field will be emptied.

Actual

Accepted: 2 updated; both tickets' Priority went from High/Low to empty (history 'priority High → null'). No warning.

Request and response (from the run, ids shortened)

POST /modules/{tickets}/records/mass-update {record_ids:[2], data:[{field: priority, value:{kind: null}}]} → 200 updated 2

Zoho Desk

Zoho (live, 13 Nov): the value list shows the empty choice as a labelled, pre-selected option -None-, so the agent sees the field will be set to none. TAVI shows the placeholder Select, which reads as nothing chosen. Saving in Zoho was not tried (it would change Zoho data).

Evidence

Dialog at the moment of Update.

Gaps against Zoho found in this wave

  • Contact portal access: after 'Invite to Help Center' the contact shows no access status or Revoke (W5-08).
  • No personal time zone / date format on My Profile (W5-71).
  • Still missing (in NDC-2760): Privacy page (record-level export/erase personal data exists), Languages page, Buttons, Marketplace, Developer space, public API keys page.
  • Notes: legal hold only blocks automatic deletion (by design, stated on the page); empty CSV import gives no reason; bulk Close from the list is not in the Bulk Actions Log; custom-action placement on tickets not found; system module names stay English in Arabic; Overview dashboard ~3.4 s.

Known Plane tickets

  • Filed 13 Nov 2026 (Bug, 4 assignees, module Desk, Sprint 16, annotated TAVI-vs-Zoho image on each): NDC-3022 E7 High, NDC-3023 E4 High, NDC-3024 W5-17 Medium, NDC-3025 E1 Low, NDC-3026 E2 Low, NDC-3027 E3 Low.
  • Known and still open: NDC-2174 (layout default status), NDC-2635 (activities gaps), NDC-2760 (missing features).

Inconclusive and not run

  • W5-08 portal revoke not found; W5-10 no parent account (Zoho check); W5-12 sync badges without help; W5-16 contract needs a support plan; W5-21 / W5-55 reused from earlier retests; W5-71 no personal time zone; W5-72 timing; W5-73 agent C can edit/delete products (depends on profile).
